$comment: One entry per Apify actor exposed as an MCP tool. To add an actor, append an entry: no code changes needed. Parameter types: string, integer, number, boolean, string[]. 'summary' is a template filled from each result item ({field}, {a,b} = first present field, {field|join} for arrays); items with an 'error' field use 'errorSummary'. Optional: itemNoun (what one result row is, if not the charged unit), chargeCountField (item field holding the number of charged events in that row), itemPriceRules ([{when:{field:value}, priceUsd}], first match sets that row's price), defaults (actor input used when the caller omits a param), extraCharges ([{countField, priceUsd, noun}]: further events billed per row, e.g. audio minutes or clips), summaryRules ([{when:{field:value}, summary}]: first match replaces 'summary' for that row, for actors that return several row types). Template fields may use dotted paths (ssl.valid); an empty array renders as 'none'. Also optional: comingSoon (true while the actor is still private on the Apify Store: the tool is listed with a COMING SOON notice and a 404 is explained; delete it or set false when the actor is public), fixedInput (actor input always sent, not exposed as a param), shortDescription + priceText (used by scripts/sync-meta.mjs for manifest.json and README.md).

actors.title: Extract frames from videos
actors.description: Extract still frames from video files reachable by direct URL (MP4, MOV, WEBM, MKV, AVI, M4V, MPEG-TS; not YouTube or TikTok pages): an automatic storyboard of scene changes, scene cuts only, N evenly spaced frames, or one frame every N seconds. Returns public image URLs with timestamps for every frame, a free contact-sheet grid image, and the video's duration, resolution, fps and codecs. Use it to let a vision model 'watch' a video, to make thumbnails or storyboards, or to find scene changes. A call must finish within 300 seconds, so send one or a few short videos per call. Cost: $0.002 per frame extracted (default 12 frames per video = $0.024), billed to your Apify account; videos that fail to download or decode are free.

videoUrls.description: Direct links to video files, e.g. ["https://media.w3.org/2010/05/sintel/trailer.mp4"].

mode.description: "auto" (default): first frame + strongest scene changes, topped up with evenly spaced frames to frameCount. "scenes": only real cuts (up to maxFramesPerVideo). "count": exactly frameCount evenly spaced frames. "interval": one frame every intervalSeconds (up to maxFramesPerVideo).

frameCount.description: Frames per video in auto and count modes. Default 12. Each frame is charged.

intervalSeconds.description: Seconds between frames in interval mode. Default 10.

maxFramesPerVideo.description: Upper limit per video in scenes and interval modes. Default 50.

sceneThreshold.description: Scene-change sensitivity (lower finds subtler changes). Default "0.3".

maxWidth.description: Scale frames down to this width in px (0 = original). Default 1280, plenty for vision models.

contactSheet.description: Also build one grid image of all frames with timecodes (free). Default true.

actors.summary: {fileName,videoUrl}: {frameCount} frames from a {durationSeconds}s {width}x{height} video; contact sheet {contactSheetUrl}
actors.shortDescription: Extract scene-change or evenly spaced frames from video files, with public image links, timestamps and a free contact sheet.

actors.title: Turn a video into LLM context
actors.description: Turn video files reachable by direct URL into context an AI model can read: a scene list, one keyframe image per scene (public links), the speech transcript (OpenAI Whisper, 99 languages) aligned to each scene, one labelled grid image of all keyframes, and a ready-to-paste 'llmContext' text block with one block per scene (time range, image link, speech). No LLM inside: use it so you can summarize, chapter, tag or answer questions about a video. Not for YouTube/TikTok/Instagram pages (refused, free). Speech recognition runs at about 0.3x real time and a call must finish within 300 seconds, so send one video of up to about 10-12 minutes per call (or set transcribe=false for keyframes only, which takes seconds). Cost: $0.002 per keyframe extracted (default up to 12 per video) + $0.008 per started audio minute transcribed (only when speech is found), billed to your Apify account; e.g. a 10-minute webinar with 12 scenes = $0.104. The grid image, metadata and scene list are free; failed or refused videos are free.

videoUrls.description: Direct links to video files (MP4, MOV, WEBM, MKV, AVI, M4V, MPEG-TS; S3/R2/GCS, a CDN, Dropbox or Google Drive share links), e.g. ["https://media.w3.org/2010/05/sintel/trailer.mp4"]. Not YouTube/TikTok/Instagram pages.

maxKeyframes.description: Most scenes (= keyframes) per video. Default 12; 8-16 suits most prompts. Each keyframe is charged.

transcribe.description: Transcribe the speech and align it to the scenes ($0.008 per started audio minute). Default true.

language.description: "auto" (default) or a 2-letter language code (en, es, de, ja...) to skip detection; helps short clips.

sceneThreshold.description: Cut sensitivity (lower finds subtler cuts). Default "0.3".

gridImage.description: Also build one labelled image of every keyframe (free). Default true.

includeImageUrlsInContext.description: Put the image links into llmContext. Default true.

keyframeMaxWidth.description: Scale keyframes down to this width in px (0 = original). Default 1024.

actors.summary: {fileName,videoUrl}: {sceneCount} scenes, {billedKeyframes} keyframes, {billedAudioMinutes} audio minute(s) from a {durationSeconds}s {width}x{height} video; grid {gridImageUrl}
actors.shortDescription: Turn a video file into AI-readable context: scene list, one keyframe per scene, Whisper transcript per scene and a ready-to-paste text block.

actors.title: Detect shots and cuts in videos
actors.description: Find every shot in video files reachable by direct URL and return a shot list: start/end time, frame numbers, SMPTE timecode and transition type (cut, dissolve or fade) per shot, one keyframe image per shot, a shot sheet image (storyboard), pacing stats (shot count, cuts per minute, average shot length) and links to the shot list as CSV, JSON and a frame-accurate CMX3600 EDL for Premiere Pro, DaVinci Resolve or Avid. Optionally splits the video into one clip per shot without re-encoding. Use it for ad teardowns, editing, or cutting long videos into single-shot clips. Not for YouTube/TikTok/Instagram pages (refused, free). A 10-minute 1080p video takes about 4-5 minutes, and a call must finish within 300 seconds, so send short videos (ads, clips, up to about 5 minutes) per call. Cost: $0.018 per started video minute (1440p counts 2, 4K counts 4) + $0.002 per clip when splitClips is true, billed to your Apify account; keyframes, shot sheet and CSV/JSON/EDL files are included; failed or refused videos are free.

videoUrls.description: Direct links to video files (MP4, MOV, WEBM, MKV, AVI, M4V, MPEG-TS; S3/R2/GCS, a CDN, Dropbox or Google Drive share links), e.g. ["https://media.w3.org/2010/05/sintel/trailer.mp4"]. Not YouTube/TikTok/Instagram pages.

threshold.description: How big a picture change must be to count as a cut. Default 0.12; raise (0.2-0.3) for fewer shots, lower (0.06-0.1) for dark or low-contrast footage.

minShotSeconds.description: Cuts closer together than this are merged. Default 0.5.

detectDissolves.description: Also find dissolves and fades through black. Default true.

keyframes.description: One image from the middle of every shot (included in the price). Default true.

shotSheetImage.description: One labelled storyboard image of all shots (included). Default true.

splitClips.description: Also cut one clip file per shot without re-encoding ($0.002 per clip). Default false.

maxClips.description: Clips are cut for the first N shots only. Default 200.

actors.summary: {fileName,videoUrl}: {shotCount} shots ({hardCutCount} cuts, {dissolveCount} dissolves, {fadeCount} fades), {cutsPerMinute} cuts/min in {durationSeconds}s; EDL {edlUrl}; shot sheet {shotSheetImageUrl}
actors.shortDescription: Detect every shot in a video file: cut, dissolve and fade timecodes, keyframes, a shot sheet and CSV/JSON/EDL files, optional clips.
actors.priceText: $0.018 per video minute (+ $0.002 per clip with splitClips)

actors.title: Upscale images with AI
actors.description: Enlarge images 2x or 4x with Real-ESRGAN, the open-source AI super-resolution model, run inside the actor (no third-party AI API): sharper edges and textures, less blur and JPEG noise than a normal resize. Two models: "general" for photos, product shots, screenshots and scans; "anime" for anime, cartoons, illustrations, logos and line art. Transparency is kept. Returns a public download URL for each upscaled file with input and output dimensions. Use it to make small product photos, thumbnails or artwork print- or store-ready, or to enlarge small text before OCR. Inputs up to about 0.3 megapixels (640x480) are standard price (output up to 2560x1920 at 4x); bigger inputs are reduced to that size unless allowLargeImages is true, which upscales inputs up to about 2.1 MP (1920x1080) at full size at the large price. Upscaling takes about 12 s per standard image and about 80 s per large one, and a call must finish within 300 s, so send at most about 15 standard or 3 large images per call. Only images you have the right to process; social-network and stock-photo links are refused. Cost: $0.01 per image upscaled, $0.06 per large image, billed to your Apify account; failed or refused images are free.

imageUrls.description: Direct links to images (JPEG, PNG, WEBP, GIF first frame, BMP, TIFF; up to 40 MB), e.g. ["https://example.com/product-small.jpg"].

model.description: "general" (default) for photos and real-world images; "anime" for anime, cartoons, illustrations and line art.

outputFormat.description: "jpeg" (default, smallest for photos), "png" (lossless, keeps transparency) or "webp" (small, keeps transparency).

allowLargeImages.description: Upscale inputs up to ~2.1 MP at full size and charge the large price ($0.06). Default false: bigger inputs are first reduced to ~0.3 MP and charged $0.01.

actors.shortDescription: Upscale images 2x or 4x with Real-ESRGAN (photo or anime model), transparency kept, with public download links.
actors.priceText: $0.01 per image ($0.06 per large image with allowLargeImages)

actors.title: Extract slides from lecture and webinar videos
actors.description: Turn lecture, webinar, conference-talk or screen-recording files reachable by direct URL into their unique slides: one image per slide (public link) with start/end timestamps, the text on each slide (OCR: English, Chinese, Japanese, Korean, Cyrillic, Arabic, Devanagari, Greek, Thai and accented Latin), one PDF of all slides, a contact sheet and an 'allText' field with every slide's text. Duplicates are removed, slides that build up bullet by bullet are merged into their final version and speaker-only shots are skipped. Returns one row per slide (type 'slide') plus one summary row per video (type 'video', with pdfUrl, contactSheetUrl, allText). Use it to get the deck that was presented, make notes or feed slide text to a model. Not for YouTube/TikTok/Instagram pages (refused, free). OCR takes about 1-1.5 s per English slide (3-9 s on dense non-English screens) and a call must finish within 300 seconds, so send one video of up to about 20 minutes per call. Cost: $0.004 per unique slide + $0.001 per started video minute scanned, billed to your Apify account; e.g. a 10-minute webinar with 15 slides = $0.07. The PDF, contact sheet and text are included; duplicates, blank frames, failed and refused videos are free.

videoUrls.description: Direct links to video files (MP4, MOV, WEBM, MKV, AVI, M4V, MPEG-TS; S3/R2/GCS, a CDN, Dropbox or Google Drive share links), e.g. ["https://example.com/recordings/lecture-03.mp4"]. Not YouTube/TikTok/Instagram pages.

sensitivity.description: How small a change counts as a new slide. "medium" (default) suits most decks; "low" gives fewer slides (screen recordings); "high" keeps subtle changes such as one changed number.

minSlideSeconds.description: A picture must stay still at least this long to count as a slide. Default 2.

ocr.description: Read the text on every slide (included in the slide price). Default true.

ocrLanguage.description: Script of the slide text. "en" (default) also reads Chinese and Japanese; "latin" for French, German, Spanish, Czech, Polish and other accented Latin languages; "cyrillic" for Russian, Ukrainian, Bulgarian.

outputPdf.description: Combine all slides of a video into one PDF (free, link in the summary row). Default true.

contactSheet.description: Also save one overview image of every slide with its start time (free). Default true.

maxWidth.description: Scale slides down to this width in px (0 = the video's full resolution). Default 1920.

maxSlidesPerVideo.description: Upper limit per video (the first N slides in time order are kept). Default 300.

actors.summary: {fileName,videoUrl}: {status}, {slideCount} slides from a {durationSeconds}s video, {billedMinutes} video minute(s) billed; PDF {pdfUrl,contactSheetUrl}
actors.shortDescription: Extract every unique slide from lecture, webinar and screen-recording files as images with timestamps, slide text (OCR) and one PDF.

actors.title: Read on-screen text in videos (video OCR)
actors.description: Extract the text shown on screen in video files reachable by direct URL: burned-in subtitles, captions, ad hook text, titles, lower-thirds (names and job titles), slide and screen-recording text. A frame is read every sampleIntervalSeconds (default 1 s) and the same text in the same place over consecutive frames is merged into one timed segment. Returns one row per text segment (type 'text': text, start/end time, position, confidence, frame image link) plus one summary row per video (type 'video': fullText transcript with times, hookText = text in the first 3 seconds, SRT and VTT links). Can also read frame images instead of videos: pass frameUrls (e.g. the frame links from extract_video_frames) or the datasetId of a Video Frame Extractor run, and leave videoUrls out. This reads WRITTEN text, not speech. Not for YouTube/TikTok/Instagram pages (refused, free). OCR takes about 0.3-0.5 s per captioned frame (about 2 s on dense screen text) and a call must finish within 300 seconds, so send about 5 minutes of video per call at the default interval (raise sampleIntervalSeconds to 2-5 for slides and screen recordings). Cost: $0.002 per frame in which text was found, billed to your Apify account; frames without text, blank or unchanged frames, failed and refused videos are free, so a video with no on-screen text costs $0. E.g. a 37-second promo with burned-in subtitles = 32 frames = $0.064.

videoUrls.description: Direct links to video files (MP4, MOV, WEBM, MKV, AVI, M4V, MPEG-TS; S3/R2/GCS, a CDN, Dropbox or Google Drive share links), e.g. ["https://example.com/recordings/lecture-03.mp4"]. Not YouTube/TikTok/Instagram pages.

frameUrls.description: Image links (JPG, PNG, WEBP) to read instead of, or as well as, videos, e.g. the frame links returned by extract_video_frames (their timestamps are kept).

datasetId.description: ID of a finished Video Frame Extractor run's dataset (or any dataset with image links in frames[].url, url or imageUrl) to read instead of videos.

sampleIntervalSeconds.description: Read a frame every N seconds. Default 1 (catches every subtitle and caption); 0.5 for fast word-by-word captions; 2-5 for slides, screen recordings and long videos.

ocrLanguage.description: Script of the on-screen text. "en" (default) also reads Chinese and Japanese; "latin" for French, German, Spanish, Portuguese, Czech, Polish; "cyrillic" for Russian, Ukrainian, Bulgarian.

textRegion.description: Where to look for text: "full" (default) whole frame; "bottom" lower 45 % (subtitles, captions, lower-thirds, skips signs and logos); "top" upper 45 % (titles, tickers).

minConfidence.description: Drop text read with lower OCR confidence. Default 0.7; 0.6 for small or stylised text, 0.85 to drop noise from busy backgrounds.

minTextLength.description: Ignore text blocks shorter than this many letters/digits. Default 2.

maxFramesPerVideo.description: Upper limit of frames read per video; longer videos are sampled evenly instead. Caps the cost per video at this many frames x $0.002. Default 600.

actors.summary: {fileName,videoUrl,source}: {status}, {segmentCount} text segment(s), {framesWithText} frame(s) with text charged; SRT {srtUrl,vttUrl}
actors.shortDescription: Extract on-screen text from video files (burned-in subtitles, captions, hook text, lower-thirds, slide text) as timed segments with a transcript and SRT/VTT.

actors.title: Transcribe Douyin videos (Chinese speech to text, SRT)
actors.description: Get the transcript of public Douyin (抖音) videos: punctuated Chinese text, timed segments and ready SRT + WebVTT subtitles, plus the video's metadata (title, hashtags, publish date, duration, author and follower count, likes, comments, shares, saves, music, Douyin's own chapter summary). Accepts douyin.com/video/<id> links, v.douyin.com share links, the whole share text copied from the Douyin app, or 19-digit video IDs; or a collection (合集) link to transcribe a whole series in episode order. Speech recognition is SenseVoice-Small (Mandarin, Cantonese, English, Japanese, Korean). No login or cookies. One row per video in input order. A one-minute video takes about 15-30 s, so send up to about 8 short videos per call (300 s sync limit). Cost: $0.004 per finished transcript (includes the first minute of audio) + $0.003 per further started minute, billed to your Apify account; deleted, private, non-embeddable videos, image posts, music-only clips and duplicates are free. E.g. a 26-second clip = $0.004, a 2:30 video = $0.010. (Translation is available on the actor itself with 4 GB memory; not exposed here.)

videoUrls.description: Douyin video links, v.douyin.com share links, pasted share text or video IDs, e.g. ["https://www.douyin.com/video/7534679152504376595"].

collectionUrls.description: Douyin collection (合集) links, e.g. ["https://www.douyin.com/collection/<ID>"]; videos are read in episode order, capped by maxVideosPerSource.

maxVideosPerSource.description: Most videos taken from each collection. Default 20; keep it at 5-8 per call because of the 300 s limit.

maxVideoMinutes.description: Longer videos are skipped for free. Default 30.

actors.shortDescription: Transcribe public Douyin (抖音) videos to punctuated Chinese text with timed segments, SRT/VTT subtitles and video metadata.

actors.title: Search 1688.com wholesale products and suppliers
actors.description: Find wholesale products and suppliers on 1688.com (Alibaba's China domestic wholesale marketplace) by keyword, by photo (1688's own image search) or by product link. Each row: Chinese title, CNY and USD price, units sold, repurchase rate, supplier name, city, years on 1688, service scores and verified-factory / Super Factory badges. With includeDetails (always on for product links) also the minimum order quantity (MOQ), quantity price tiers, every SKU with price, stock, weight and box size, attributes, rating and ships-from. Chinese keywords match best (e.g. "瑜伽垫" for yoga mats); English also works. No 1688 account or cookies. Keep calls small (about 20-60 products, or up to 20 with includeDetails) because of the 300 s sync limit. Cost, billed to your Apify account: $0.0009 per product + $0.001 per product page (includeDetails) + $0.0005 per image match, with at most 7 matches charged per 60 matches of one photo; blocked, not-found and filtered-out rows are free. E.g. 20 products with pages = $0.038.

productUrls.description: 1688 product links or offer IDs, e.g. ["https://detail.1688.com/offer/787646790056.html"]; always returns the full product page.

imageUrls.description: Public product photo links (JPG/PNG/WebP) to search 1688 by image, e.g. an Amazon or AliExpress product photo.

maxItemsPerKeyword.description: Most products per keyword. Default 20 here.

includeDetails.description: Also open each product page for MOQ, price tiers and SKUs ($0.001 extra per product). Default false.

supplierType.description: Only manufacturers, verified real factories or Super Factories. Default any.

actors.shortDescription: Search 1688.com (China wholesale) by keyword, photo or link: CNY/USD prices, MOQ, price tiers, SKUs and supplier badges.
actors.priceText: $0.0009 per product + $0.001 per product page + $0.0005 per image match
